materialClaimCorrection.claim: SQL readers independently require auth.uid consistency
materialClaimCorrection.fact: the RPC client is the Supabase service-role admin client; its JWT has no subject so auth.uid() is null and the clause never denies; a user JWT would be refused by the role check anyway
materialClaimCorrection.proves: named actor holds clinical_admin and scope is approved; not that the actor made the request
